description: One grouped PR a week for everything non-major, automerged once the required checks pass; majors wait in the Dependency Dashboard until ticked and are merged by hand.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: The runtime image's rustup install, so it moves with rust-toolchain.toml instead of drifting (it was 1.90.0 against a 1.93.1 toolchain).

packageRules.description: In-range npm minors only reach the weekly PR if the lockfile is updated for them; the default would wait for lockFileMaintenance.
Rust toolchain in its own PR: rust-toolchain.toml, the builder image and the runtime rustup install together. A new clippy lint set must not block the weekly group.
Majors open one PR per package, only once ticked in the Dependency Dashboard issue, and are never automerged.
Automerge non-major updates through GitHub's auto-merge, which waits for main's required checks (CI OK, the CLA) and review rules.
CI and build-image updates change what runs on every pull request: always reviewed by hand.
